events.text: Show first broadcast on the BBC Light Programme, starting its run

evidence.quote: From its inception in 1964 , Many a Slip was broadcast on the BBC Light Programme

events.text: Original broadcast moved to BBC Radio 4, repeats moved to BBC Radio 2

evidence.quote: In July 1969 , this changed , with the original broadcast now on BBC Radio 4

events.text: BBC Radio 2 stopped broadcasting the weekly repeats

evidence.quote: Radio 2 stopped broadcasting the weekly repeats in 1970

events.text: Lance Percival returned to the panel after David Nixon's death

evidence.quote: When Nixon died in 1978 , Percival returned to the show
remained until the show ended in 1979

undated_mentions: early 1970s: Katharine Whitehorn and Paul Jennings replaced Isobel Barnett and Richard Murdoch as panellists
after one series: Tim Rice and Gillian Reynolds replaced Whitehorn and Jennings as panellists
when the annual radio series returned: David Nixon replaced Lance Percival as panellist
mid-1960s: show tried out on television for one series
1980s: show broadcast on Saturday nights on RNZ National, New Zealand
late 1990s: BBC recorded a pilot at the Radio Theatre, Broadcasting House
